reviews.review: This game is better than left 4 dead, left 4 dead is ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ compared to this game. I will die on this ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ hill, 1v1 me nuketown ballistic knives ONLY quickscope ONLY !!!!!!
[i]Game had potential at launch until the dev team decided the game would be better [b]left 4 dead[/b].[/i]

If friendship had a zombie apocalypse simulator, this would be it.

Back 4 Blood is insanely fun with friends. The gunplay? Chef’s kiss. Blasting zombies, mutants, and whatever those twitchy meat monsters are is extremely satisfying. The guns feel powerful, the headshots are juicy, and the chaos is glorious. There’s a real dopamine hit every time you clear a room with a legendary modded-out beast of a rifle.

But here’s where the heartbreak sets in.

You spend an act lovingly building your dream weapon—scoping in like a COD sniper, tricked out with epic attachments, feeling like the zombie John Wick… only to lose it the moment the act ends. WHY. 😭 It’s like growing attached to a puppy only to be told, “Thanks, but you’re back to this crusty pistol now.” I get it—balance and all—but come on. Let me keep something. The attachment system had so much potential to feel progressive, not like a reset button after every act.

Also, the whole “fail twice, start the act over” thing? Feels like being grounded by the game for getting too cocky. It keeps you on your toes, sure—but also makes me want to yeet my keyboard when we wipe at the end of a long run.

That said, the game still slaps. The acts all have a unique vibe, and some of the set pieces are genuinely epic. The hives are a fun touch, although they start to feel a bit copy-paste after a while. We loved the inner hive loot cave (seriously, it felt like finding buried treasure), but of course—OF COURSE—we found that shiny epic gun right before the act ended. So long, sweet AR. 😢

In short:

Gunplay? 10/10

Team shenanigans? 11/10

Losing your fully pimped weapon? 0/10 emotional trauma

Overall? A chaotic, bloody, beautiful mess.

Still playing, still laughing, still arguing with my mates over attachments. Will update after more hours—and probably more therapy over lost loot.

left 4 dead comparisons aside, this game is pretty fine. No super strong opinions on it. I didn't play it for long on Xbox or Steam, but I never had a bad time- I just think this didn't grab me but I can see others spending hundreds of hours in this. I think the loop of gameplay is a lot more underwhelming to me than left 4 dead, but I don't really know wh- dang it... already made a left 4 dead comparison... Warner Bros. are gonna take me out back soon. Sayonara everyone...
